svg.title: AgentVault logical architecture
svg.desc: Payment decisions, settlement evidence, and control boundaries Control boundaries separate the browser, AuthGuard, business applications, AgentVault, external services, and infrastructure. Connections are numbered per invocation flow; abbreviations and sequence prefixes are explained in the footer.
svg.text: Payment decisions, settlement evidence, and control boundaries
Implemented boundaries · standard HTTP SDKs · authoritative SQL · external settlement

g.text: History reads · approval decisions · supported configuration
SDKs execute inside their host processes.
Trusted principal adapter → role-specific routes and handlers
Shared domain and SQL transaction boundary
Catalog + encrypted key versions + shared-wallet limits
Atomic commits · ordered locks · leases · deduplication
Payment invariant: a signature is not settlement; only trusted evidence can commit a Ledger posting. No business message broker is required.
Sequence IDs: A = access; P = outbound payment; I = inbound collection; R = recovery; B = bootstrap / projection.
Independent calls: D1 = SQL; C1 = cache; T1 = telemetry; O1 = private operations; X1 = configured external infrastructure.
Numbers follow each flow, not one global clock. Replies return on the same path; P1 repeats with the authorized Credential.
Solid arrow: call; reply uses the same path
Boundary boxes indicate ownership, not a hop
